2026-07-11 identity / dom-morphing / components
e9fafb2 3141208

Component identity stopped depending on sibling position

Source signatures and explicit keys made component preservation reliable when lists insert, remove, or reorder children.

<!-- account-list.fez -->
<script>
  class {
    init() {
      this.state.accounts = [
        { id: 7, name: 'Personal' },
        { id: 12, name: 'Studio' },
      ]
    }

    reverse() {
      this.state.accounts.reverse()
    }
  }
</script>

<button onclick="fez.reverse()">Reverse</button>

{#each state.accounts as account}
  <account-row key={account.id} :account="account"></account-row>
{/each}

<!-- account-row.fez -->
<script>
  class {
    PROPS = {
      account: { type: Object, required: true },
    }
  }
</script>

<label>
  {props.account.name}
  <input placeholder="Unsaved note" />
</label>
